en: Sura 89: Al-Fajr
ja: 第89章 暁章

p.src: 89:1  By the dawn,

en: By the dawn,
ja: 暁にかけて、[1]
u.src: 89:1  By the dawn,

ja: [1]　アーヤ*1－４における、アッラー*によるこの誓いについては、整列者章1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 89:2  and the ten nights[1],

en: and the ten nights[1],
ja: また、十夜[1]にかけて、
u.src: 89:2  and the ten nights[1],

en: [1] i.e., the first ten nights of the lunar month of Dhul-Hijjah.
ja: [1]　この「十夜」は、非常に徳が多いとされる、ズル＝ヒッジャ*月の最初の十日間であるとされる（イブン・カスィール８：３９０－３９1参照）。

p.src: 89:3  and the even and the odd[2],

en: and the even and the odd[2],
ja: また、偶数と奇数[1]にかけて、
u.src: 89:3  and the even and the odd[2],

en: [2] Of the things.
ja: [1]　この「偶数と奇数」の解釈には、それぞれ「奇数回と偶数回の礼拝」「アラファの日（ズル＝ヒッジャ*月九日」とイード*・アル＝アドハー（同月十日の犠牲祭）」「（つがいとして、あるいは対極的な別のものと共に創られた）創造物と（唯一である）アッラー*」「文字通り、偶数と奇数、つまり全ての数」など、非常に多くの説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー2０：３９－４1参照）。

p.src: 89:4  and by the night when it comes,

en: and by the night when it comes,
ja: また、（その闇と共に）流れ行く夜にかけて（誓う）。
u.src: 89:4  and by the night when it comes,

p.src: 89:5  are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?

en: are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?
ja: その中には、分別ある者への誓いがあるのではないか？
u.src: 89:5  are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?

p.src: 89:6  Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād
ja: （使徒*よ、）一体あなたは、あなたの主*がアード*に対してされたことを、見なかったのか？
u.src: 89:6  Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

p.src: 89:7  of Iram[3], who were people of great stature,

en: of Iram[3], who were people of great stature,
ja: 柱の主、イラム[1]に対して？
u.src: 89:7  of Iram[3], who were people of great stature,

en: [3] Iram: an ancient tribe; or a well-known tribe in Yemen; or the grandfather of the people of ‘Aad, etc. Prophet Hūd was sent to the people of ‘Aad.
ja: [1]　「イラム」は、アード*の民の部族名。彼らの住居は、「柱」によって非常に高く建築されたものだったとされる（ムヤッサル５９３頁参照）。

p.src: 89:8  the like of whom had never been created in the land;

en: the like of whom had never been created in the land;
ja: 諸国において、それと同様の（強靭かつ強力な）ものは創られたことがなかった（、イラムに対して）。
u.src: 89:8  the like of whom had never been created in the land;

p.src: 89:9  and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;

en: and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;
ja: また、渓谷で岩を切り抜い（て、住居とし）たサムード*に対して？
u.src: 89:9  and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;

p.src: 89:10  and the mighty and powerful[4] Pharaoh?

en: and the mighty and powerful[4] Pharaoh?
ja: また、杭[1]の主フィルアウン*に対して？
u.src: 89:10  and the mighty and powerful[4] Pharaoh?

en: [4] Or the owner of the stakes by which he used to torture people.
ja: [1]　この「杭」については、サード章12の訳注を参照。

p.src: 89:11  All of them transgressed in the land,

en: All of them transgressed in the land,
ja: （彼ら不信仰の民*は、）諸国で放埓さの限りを尽くし、
u.src: 89:11  All of them transgressed in the land,

p.src: 89:12  and spread therein much corruption,

en: and spread therein much corruption,
ja: そこにおいて腐敗*を散々行い、
u.src: 89:12  and spread therein much corruption,

p.src: 89:13  so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

en: so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ja: それで、あなたの主*がその上に、懲罰の鞭を浴びせられた者たち。
u.src: 89:13  so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

p.src: 89:14  Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

en: Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.
ja: （使徒*よ、）本当にあなたの主*は、監視の場におられるのだ。
u.src: 89:14  Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

p.src: 89:15  As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[5]!”

en: As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[5]!”
ja: 人間というものは、その主*が彼を試練におかけになり、栄誉をお授けになり、恩恵を与え給うた時には、（こう）言う。「我が主*は、私に栄誉をお授けになった」。
u.src: 89:15  As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[5]!”

en: [5] Instead of being grateful, he is proud, attributing the favor to his own merit.

p.src: 89:16  But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”

en: But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”
ja: そして、かれが彼を試練におかけになり、彼にその糧を控えられた時には、（こう）言うのだ。「我が主*は、私を卑しめられた」。[1]
u.src: 89:16  But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”

ja: [1]　現世におけるアッラー*からの厚遇と恩恵を、アッラー*の御許における自分自身の高貴さと、かれと特別な間柄ゆえのものと考え、逆の場合には、それが自分に対するアッラー*からの卑下（ひげ）であると考える、人間の一般的な性向を示している。しかし物質的な状況の良し悪しは、いずれもアッラー*からの試練なのであり、アッラー*はそのような状況において人が感謝するか、また忍耐*するかをご覧になるのである（アッ＝サアディー９2３頁参照）。サバア章３６とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 89:17  No indeed[6]! You are not kind to the orphan,

en: No indeed[6]! You are not kind to the orphan,
ja: 断じて（、そのような考えは正しく）ない！いや、（栄誉はアッラー*への服従、辱めはかれへの反抗によるものなのだ[1]、）あなた方は孤児を手厚く扱わず、
u.src: 89:17  No indeed[6]! You are not kind to the orphan,

en: [6] It is not as you think. Allah puts people to test through prosperity and hardship and rewards their gratitude and patience in the Hereafter.
ja: [1]　関連するアーヤ*として、婦人章７９、相談章３０とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 89:18  nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

en: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,
ja: 貧者*らに食べさせることも勧め合わず、
u.src: 89:18  nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

p.src: 89:19  and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[7],

en: and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[7],
ja: 遺産をごっそりと貪り、
u.src: 89:19  and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[7],

en: [7] Whether lawful or unlawful.

p.src: 89:20  and love wealth immensely.

en: and love wealth immensely.
ja: 財産をこよなく愛している。
u.src: 89:20  and love wealth immensely.

p.src: 89:21  No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

en: No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,
ja: 断じて（、そのような状態は正しく）ない！大地が木っ端微塵に、粉々にされ、[1]
u.src: 89:21  No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

ja: [1]　復活の日*の天変地異の様子については、洞窟章４７、ター・ハー章1０５－1０７、蟻章８８、山章９－1０、出来事章５－６、衣を纏（まと）う者章1４、真実章1３－1５、階段章８－９、消息章2０、巻き込む章３、衝撃章４－５なども参照。

p.src: 89:22  and your Lord comes[8] with the angels, rank after rank,

en: and your Lord comes[8] with the angels, rank after rank,
ja: あなたの主*と、次から次へと隊列を組んだ天使*が到来し、[1]
u.src: 89:22  and your Lord comes[8] with the angels, rank after rank,

en: [8] To pass judgment between people.
ja: [1]　同様の状況を示すアーヤ*として、雌牛章21０とその訳注、識別章2５、真実章1５－1７も参照。

p.src: 89:23  and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?

en: and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?
ja: その日、地獄がもたらされる時[1]、その日に（不信仰な）人間は教訓を受け（、悔悟す）る[2]。（現世は終わってしまったというのに、）教訓（と悔悟）が、どうして彼の役に立とうか？
u.src: 89:23  and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?

ja: [1]　その日、地獄は七万の手綱をつけられて、持って来られる。その各々の手綱には、それを引っ張る七万の天使*がついている（ムスリム「天国とその享楽、及びその住人の描写の書」2９、イブン・カスィール８：３９９参照）。 [2]　復活の日*の悔悟については、家畜章1５８とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 89:24  He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”

en: He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”
ja: 彼は言う。「あぁ、（来世での）我が人生のため、あらかじめ（現世で、有益な行いを）しておけばよかった！」
u.src: 89:24  He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”

p.src: 89:25  None can punish as He punishes on that Day,

en: None can punish as He punishes on that Day,
ja: その日、誰もかれ（アッラー*）の懲罰のように罰することはなく、
u.src: 89:25  None can punish as He punishes on that Day,

p.src: 89:26  and none can bind as He binds.

en: and none can bind as He binds.
ja: 誰も、かれの縛り方のように縛ることはない。
u.src: 89:26  and none can bind as He binds.

p.src: 89:27  [It will be said to the believer,] “O the tranquil soul!

en: [It will be said to the believer,] “O the tranquil soul!
ja: （アッラー*の唱念と、かれへの信仰へと）安らぐ魂よ、
u.src: 89:27  [It will be said to the believer,] “O the tranquil soul!

p.src: 89:28  Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].

en: Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].
ja: （アッラー*からの御もてなしに）満足し、（アッラー*から）ご満悦を受けつつ、あなたの主*へと戻るがよい。
u.src: 89:28  Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].

p.src: 89:29  Join My [righteous] slaves,

en: Join My [righteous] slaves,
ja: そして、わが（正しき）僕たちのところに入り、
u.src: 89:29  Join My [righteous] slaves,

p.src: 89:30  and enter My Paradise.”

en: and enter My Paradise.”
ja: （彼らと共に、）わが楽園に入るのだ。
u.src: 89:30  and enter My Paradise.”
